name: print-social-slate-spacing-base-unit-square-scale-post
title: Spacing Base Unit Scale Post
whatItIs: A slate-blue slide, Rule 1 Spacing, with a light sentence 'Clean UI starts with consistent spacing', a list of base units 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32 and a row of cream squares growing in size across the bottom edge.
whatItMeans: Squares that grow by the same steps as the numbers make the scale visible, and the layout is nearly all type and one graphic.
techniques: Squares sized to match the numbers listed
Condensed caps label above a light line
Row of squares bleeding off the right edge

vocabulary.definition: A small value that all spacing is a multiple of.
A set of allowed spacing values such as 4, 8, 16.
A shape running off the edge of the canvas.
